Because good detergent doesn't just clean - It cares
Luxury Laundry Detergent that's good for your clothes, your skin, and our planet.
INGREDIENTS
We carefully source all of our ingredients, keeping you and the planet in mind with every choice made. Our washes are paraben and phosphate free.
Water (Aqua), Sodium C14-16 Olefin Sulfonate, Polysorbate 20, Fragrance (Parfum), Glycerin, Cocamidopropyl Hydroxysultaine, Xanthan Gum, Protease, Amylase, Citric Acid, Potassium Sorbate, Sodium Benzoate.
PACKAGING
We chose metal packaging because it’s tougher, cleaner, and way easier on the planet. Unlike plastic, metal is endlessly recyclable and actually gets recycled. It keeps our formula fresh, looks beautiful in your laundry space, and helps cut down on waste. Less landfill, more style.
WHO WE ARE
We started Mozi because we wanted a detergent that was safer for us, better for the planet, and actually smelled really good. Clean ingredients, less plastic, and scents that make laundry feel like a treat—not a chore.
LEARN MORE
Bringing bold fragrance choices and irresistible packaging to laundry day with products that have blown up on TikTok. Their Cozy Cashmere scent is legendary!

Eco-Friendly Laundry, Perfected for Travel: Mozi Wash Puts Sustainability First
A staple in laundry care, fresh scents are evolving with the integration of aquatic elements. These nuances elevate traditional powdery aromas, giving them a more modern and dynamic appeal.
Mozi Wash may be another higher priced detergent on our list, but its ultra-concentrated formula means you only need to use a little each time. It comes in a few different scents, from Cozy Cashmere to Sugar dew, the latter of which smells like tropical Fruits, hibiscus, and citrus.
